                                                                                                                                        with the conjunction ‘and’




Initially, Mrs Miro presented complaining of a three-week history of progressively worsening

right breast pain with swelling, redness and warmth over the last three weeks. Upon                                                     Commented [May6]: This is ambiguous as this sentence

                                                                                                                                        to the final 3 weeks of something. I have amended this
On assessment, her right breast was mildly enlarged, firm, tender to the touch with                                                     sentence slightly for you.


periareolar erythema. Several Nnone-tender several palpable lymph nodes in the right axilla                                             Commented [May7]: ‘Non-tender’ not ‘None-tender’

now overdue. A rRight-sided mastitis was suspected. Therefore, flucloxacillin was                                                       Commented [May8]: To keep it concise. Since you have
                                                                                                                                        already mentioned that the last mammogram was four years
                                                                                                                                        ago, it is not necessary to add this part. Your letter initially
prescribed, and a mammogram and an ultrasound scan of the breasts were recommended.                                                     had 279 words.




One month later, although Mrs Miro had completed the antibiotics, no improvement was

seen. On examination, the right breast was swollen with diffused erythema, pitted skin and

a nipple retraction. A The mammogram of the right breast showed skin thickening, high                                                   Commented [May9]: No article required.
                                                                                                                                        Commented [May10]: Use the definite article ‘The’ since
density areas and an ill-defined mass deep in the center of the breast. AnThe ultrasound                                                this is the second time you are referring to the same
                                                                                                                                        mammogram.

detected the mass measuring 4mm with two enlarged right axillary lymph nodes. As a

result, an urgent core-needle biopsy of the right breast was ordered. Today, the biopsy

results revealed an infiltrating ductal carcinoma. In addition, she reported depressive

symptoms for which a referral to a psychiatrist was done.                                                                               Commented [May11]: Good flow of information!




Based on the above, yYour immediate evaluation and management of Mrs Miro’s condition                                                   Commented [May12]: This is not required as conciseness is
                                                                                                                                        important in OET

would be greatly appreciated. If you require any further clarification, please do not hesitate

to get in contact.



Yours sincerely,

Doctor
